description: This PHP source file defines the 'ResetPasswordRequest' entity class used in the OrangeHRM system for managing password reset requests. It maps to the 'ohrm_reset_password' database table and includes properties such as id, reset email, request date, reset code, and expiration status, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ResetPasswordRequest
classes.description: Entity class representing a password reset request, with properties for id, email, request date, reset code, and expiration status, mapped to the database table 'ohrm_reset_password'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reset password request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the reset password request.

methods.name: getResetEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address associated with the reset request.

methods.name: setResetEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address for the reset request.

methods.name: getResetRequestDate
methods.description: Returns the date and time when the reset request was made.

methods.name: setResetRequestDate
methods.description: Sets the date and time for the reset request.

methods.name: getResetCode
methods.description: Returns the reset code associated with the request.

methods.name: setResetCode
methods.description: Sets the reset code for the password reset request.

methods.name: getExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the reset request has expired.

methods.name: setExpired
methods.description: Sets the expiration status of the reset request.
